## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Replies from senders outside the allowlist are rejected before any decision...

The system SHALL ensure that replies from senders outside the allowlist are rejected before any decision call, asserted by a call-count test.

#### Scenario: Replies from senders outside the allowlist are rejected before any decision...

WHEN `classify-human-reply-intent-behind-the-approval-floor` is implemented
THEN Replies from senders outside the allowlist are rejected before any decision call, asserted by a call-count test.

### Requirement: approve is returned only when distribution["approve"] >= 0.97; every other...

The system SHALL ensure that approve is returned only when distribution["approve"] >= 0.97; every other case, including a degraded decision, returns guidance, covered by a parametrised test around 0.97.

#### Scenario: approve is returned only when distribution["approve"] >= 0.97; every other...

WHEN `classify-human-reply-intent-behind-the-approval-floor` is implemented
THEN approve is returned only when distribution["approve"] >= 0.97; every other case, including a degraded decision, returns guidance, covered by a parametrised test around 0.97.

### Requirement: A corpus of recorded replies shows no reply currently classified non-approve...

The system SHALL ensure that a corpus of recorded replies shows no reply currently classified non-approve becoming approve without meeting the floor.

#### Scenario: A corpus of recorded replies shows no reply currently classified non-approve...

WHEN `classify-human-reply-intent-behind-the-approval-floor` is implemented
THEN A corpus of recorded replies shows no reply currently classified non-approve becoming approve without meeting the floor.

### Requirement: The change carries a security review recording the trust-model impact, and...

The system SHALL ensure that the change carries a security review recording the trust-model impact, and every classified reply logs its distribution alongside the sender.

#### Scenario: The change carries a security review recording the trust-model impact, and...

WHEN `classify-human-reply-intent-behind-the-approval-floor` is implemented
THEN The change carries a security review recording the trust-model impact, and every classified reply logs its distribution alongside the sender.
